## Problem and change

Explain the problem, what changes, and the resulting behavior. Link a related issue if one exists.

## Verification

List exact commands and results. State what was not run and why. Distinguish fixtures,
real-checkpoint smoke tests, and linguistic evaluation.

## Review checklist

- [ ] The change preserves checkpoint architecture and existing useful behavior.
- [ ] Documentation and examples match the implementation.
- [ ] No secrets, private text, unapproved datasets, or model weights are included.
- [ ] Rights to contributed material have been discussed while licensing is unresolved.
- [ ] UI changes include relevant screenshots and keyboard/RTL checks, if applicable.
- [ ] Model claims include their source and limitations, if applicable.
